title: Two GO-BGC Argo float lifetimes and metadata
question: How do biogeochemical profiles relate to water-column stratification across cycles?
publisher: Argo / GO-BGC / NOAA AOML / IFREMER GDAC
measurement_dates: All twelve top-level files frozen at retrieval for floats 5906483 and 5906486; JULD/profile dates and DATE_UPDATE fields preserve observation/update dates independently.
variables_and_units: Variables and units are preserved in native column headers, instrument metadata and source dictionaries; see evidence anchors below.
independent_units: Float and full profile/cycle; two floats only.
validation_design: Float and full profile/cycle; two floats only. Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: GDAC profile/trajectory products with delayed-mode and real-time processing. Adjusted and unadjusted values represent alternative versions of the same measurements. GDAC files may change after retrieval.
prior_analysis_and_limits: Two floats do not establish ocean-wide transfer. Oxygen/nutrient sensor response and QC can mimic physical relationships. The GO-BGC FAQ and current citation policy are included; an obsolete optional citation URL returned 404 before the current link was located. All twelve top-level GDAC NetCDF products for floats 5906483/5906486, frozen retrieval. Raw/adjusted values and QC flags must remain distinct.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.
